scope: ECoG: within-recording randomization inference from three recordings in one animal. RNN: paired inference across eight simulated session/order seeds.

evoked_response.question: Does the evoked response to the first repetition differ from the fifteenth, at any latency in 0-360 ms?
evoked_response.statistic: GFP of the block-averaged Rep-1 evoked response minus GFP of the Rep-15 response - the quantity panel B draws - variance-normalised at each latency against its own randomisation distribution.
evoked_response.null: Rep-1/Rep-15 labels are exchangeable within a block; the null flips the sign of each block's within-block difference. Blocks are never split, so within-block dependence is preserved.
evoked_response.multiplicity: Family-wise error controlled by the maximum cluster mass over all latencies and all three deviant positions jointly.
evoked_response.scope: Three recordings from one animal. This is a within-recording randomisation test and does not license population inference across animals.

decoder.measure: classification accuracy for actual Rep 1 versus actual Rep 15 from raw 32-channel endpoint features
decoder.time_reference: sequence onset, not deviant onset; 0–600 ms at a declared 5-ms inference grid
decoder.cross_validation: five fixed context-stratified folds grouped by intact roving block; both endpoints from a block always share a fold
decoder.scaling: channel mean and sample SD fitted only on training blocks, separately for every fold and time point; SD + 1e-6
decoder.bootstrap: 95% percentile interval from 4,999 paired whole-block resamples within each of the six context→current transition strata; one set of block weights is reused across all times. Decoder fits are held fixed, so this is conditional predictive uncertainty
decoder.randomization: 4,999 Monte Carlo within-block Rep-1/Rep-15 label swaps; all five folds and training-only scaling are refit for every swap and time point
decoder.multiple_comparison: one-sided cluster mass with pointwise 95th-percentile null cluster-forming thresholds; maximum cluster jointly over all three recordings controls FWER at 0.05

solver_validation.objective: mean logistic deviance + lambda/2*||beta||^2; unpenalized bias

posterior_maps.measure: cross-fitted block-level logit(P[Rep-1-like]) evidence from the committed leakage-safe repetition-map decoder
posterior_maps.display: committed posterior_smoothed probabilities, generated by exact MATLAB imgaussfilt-equivalent replicate-padded Gaussian smoothing (sigma repetition=0.8, sigma time=3 ms), then sampled at 5 ms
posterior_maps.inference_smoothing: the same exact repetition/time Gaussian operator is applied to each block's logit evidence on the native 1-ms grid before sampling at 5 ms
posterior_maps.randomization: 4,999 whole-block Rademacher sign flips; one sign is shared by all 15 repetitions and all times within a block, preserving the complete within-block dependence structure
posterior_maps.multiple_comparison: two-sided 4-neighbor cluster mass, p<0.05 two-sided t cluster-forming threshold, maximum cluster jointly across all three maps; corrected Monte Carlo p=(b+1)/(4,999+1)
posterior_maps.scope_and_compromise: This is a cross-fitted evidence sign-flip test, not a refitted 15-repetition decoder permutation. Refitting all endpoint folds for every repetition-map cell would redefine intermediate posterior predictions and is computationally prohibitive. The test is valid under block-level symmetry of cross-fitted logits.

ecog_buildup.measure: mean single-block global field power over the prespecified 0–180 ms post-deviant window, transformed within each block as 100*(Rep-r response / Rep-1 response - 1)
ecog_buildup.uncertainty: SEM of within-block percentage changes across intact roving blocks within each recording
ecog_buildup.test: within-block percentage change versus zero, 4,999 whole-block sign flips, two-sided max-|t| correction jointly over repetitions 2–15 and all three recordings
ecog_buildup.scope: within-recording inference for three recordings from one animal; not a biological population inference

rnn.replication_unit: simulated session/order seed; positions are averaged within seed for buildup and suppression summaries
rnn.trace_test: Rep-1 minus Rep-15 paired seed differences at a 5-ms inference grid; exhaustive 2^8 two-sided seed sign flips; cluster-mass maximum jointly over the three displayed intact-condition positions and times
rnn.buildup_test: within each seed, positions are averaged first and each repetition is transformed as 100*(Rr/R1-1); exhaustive 2^8 sign flips test percentage change versus zero with two-sided max-|t| jointly over all four conditions and repetitions 2–15
rnn.suppression_test: position-averaged seed-level suppression index versus zero; exhaustive 2^8 sign flips; two-sided max-|t| over four conditions. Paired perturbation-minus-intact contrasts are additionally tested with exhaustive 2^8 sign flips and a two-sided max-|t| over the three perturbations.
rnn.suppression_interval: two-sided 95% Student-t interval across eight seed-level, position-averaged values
rnn.old_cache_fallback: If sequence_responses is absent, responses_full is placed into sequence coordinates and unavailable samples remain NaN; no inference is assigned to unavailable samples.
